All Falcon models are pretrained with a 2,048 sequence length, which
can be limiting for multi-turn chat or code use cases.

We introduce the Falcon series: 7B, 40B, and 180B parameters causal decoder-
                                                     only models trained on a diverse high-quality corpora predominantly assembled
                                                     from web data.

languages.value: predominantly English; 8% multilingual (Europe-focused); unlikely to generalize beyond English or European latin languages

source.quote:
The Falcon models are predominantly trained on English data
                                from a large-scale web corpora representative of the web. Ac-
                                cordingly, they will carry the stereotypes and biases commonly
                                encountered online

license.value: Falcon-7B and Falcon-40B Apache 2.0; Falcon-180B Falcon-180B TII license with responsible-use restrictions

source.quote:
Falcon-7B and Falcon-40B are made available under the Apache
                                2.0 license; Falcon-180B is made available under the Falcon-
                                180B TII license, with restrictions related to responsible use.

We introduce the Falcon series: 7B, 40B, and 180B parameters causal decoder-
                                                     only models trained on a diverse high-quality corpora predominantly assembled
                                                     from web data.

architecture.value: autoregressive Transformer (PaLM-based) with multigroup/multiquery attention for tensor parallelism; no SwiGLU; causal LM objective

source.quote:
Architecture based on
                                PaLM Chowdhery et al. (2022), with an extension of multiquery
                                attention for tensor parallelism (multigroup) and minor tweaks

trainingData.value: up to 3,500B tokens; ~85% RefinedWeb web data plus curated books, conversations, code, technical corpora without upsampling

source.quote:
The final Falcon mixture is predominantly web-based (nearly 85%), but includes
other curated corpora (without any upsampling) to broaden the expressiveness of the model.

findings.text: The paper reports pretrained Falcon models only and leaves downstream finetuning and alignment to future work.

source.quote:
In this paper, we primarily report on the pretraining alone of the
Falcon series of models, and leave further downstream finetuning and alignment to future works.

findings.text: Authors recommend deploying guardrails and running use-case-specific bias/harm evaluations before any Falcon deployment.

source.quote:
Prior to deployment of the Falcon models, we strongly recommend for adequate guardrails
to be deployed and for bias/harm evaluations specific to the target use case to be systematically
undertaken.

findings.text: Toxicity was assessed for the pretraining dataset (not the models) via Perspective API and reported as in line with The Pile, in the separate RefinedWeb paper; that definition excludes social biases and harmfulness.

source.quote:
We evaluated the toxicity of the underlying pretraining dataset and
                                found it to be in line with common curated pretraining datasets
                                such as The Pile, see Penedo et al. (2023).

findings.text: Lightly tuned instruct/chat variants are mentioned as available, but evaluations and claims in this paper focus on pretrained bases.

source.quote:
Although we make lightly tuned versions of the Falcon models available to
demonstrate possibilities as instruct or chat models, our work predominantly concerns the pretrained
versions.

findings.text: Falcon-180B is released under a dedicated TII license with responsible-use restrictions, unlike Apache 2.0 for 7B and 40B.

source.quote:
Falcon-7B and Falcon-40B are made available under the Apache
                                2.0 license; Falcon-180B is made available under the Falcon-
                                180B TII license, with restrictions related to responsible use.

notes: Technical report on Falcon-7B/40B/180B pretraining (arXiv 2311.16867). No dedicated safety section and no safety/alignment/honesty/jailbreak/bias benchmark numbers in this PDF. Capability tables (MMLU, HellaSwag, HumanEval, SuperGLUE, etc.) skipped under safety-only pilot rules. Dataset toxicity numbers live in Penedo et al. 2023 (RefinedWeb), not this document. Covers use base checkpoints matching Falcon-7B/40B/180B names; seed-linked instruct/chat ids left out because the paper evaluates pretrained bases. Neutral ML-filter discussion cites bias amplification literature but is about data pipeline design, not a model bias eval.
